title: Release notes from quarry

items.title: Quarry 3.2.1
items.author: dana-q
items.content:
Fixes

  • quarry restore --jobs no longer hangs when a table has no rows (#831)

items.title: Quarry 3.2.0
items.author: dana-q
items.content: Quarry 3.2 makes restores of big databases fast and stops the restore error people hit most.

item.title: Quarry 3.3.0
item.author: dana-q
item.content:
Quarry 3.3 lets an interrupted restore pick up where it stopped.

Highlights

Resume a restore

A restore cut off by a dropped connection, a reboot or Ctrl-C used to start over from the first table. quarry restore --resume now picks up at the table it was on...
